system.description:
Effect: You create a stream of liquid or foam that covers an area about 3 feet by 3 feet (1 m by 1 m) within an immediate distance. Metal in the area of level 6 or less becomes as brittle as thin glass (level 0) to a depth of about 6 inches (15 cm). To affect metal of level 7 or higher, you must succeed at an Intellect attack against it.

Genre Items: rusting gauntlet (fantasy); metal metaoxidizer (sci-fi)
